name: game-manage-kit
description: gameManageKit 游戏独立账号门户服务（HTTP-only，MySQL-only）

scripts.prepare:contract: npm run generate:contract && npm --workspace @gono/game-manage-kit-contract run build
scripts.dev: npm run prepare:contract && tsx watch --env-file=.env src/main.ts
scripts.build: npm run generate:contract && npm --workspace @gono/game-manage-kit-contract run build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run prepare:contract && tsc --noEmit && npm --workspace @gono/game-manage-kit-contract run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run prepare:contract && node --import tsx --test test/unit/*.test.ts test/contract/*.test.ts
scripts.test:int: npm run build && node --env-file=.env --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 test/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.test:docker: docker compose --profile smoke up -d --build --wait app && docker compose --profile smoke run --rm --no-deps smoke
